laws.rule: Harbin: article 31 sets fines for set conduct. It covers loud square dancing that disturbs others, graffiti or carving on trees, buildings and street furniture, spitting or urinating in public, littering, throwing objects from height, trampling lawns or snapping plants, not clearing a pet's droppings, jaywalking, and smoking in a banned place after being asked to stop.
laws.penalty_signal: Graffiti or carving: CNY 500 (about A$107) per spot. Spitting or urinating: CNY 100 (about A$21.33). Littering that is not cleared: CNY 100 (about A$21.33). Throwing from height: CNY 500 (about A$107). Trampling lawn or picking plants: CNY 100 (about A$21.33). Pet droppings not cleared: CNY 100 (about A$21.33). Smoking in a banned place after being asked to stop: CNY 200 (about A$42.66). Jaywalking: warning or CNY 20 (about A$4.27). Noise after a warning: CNY 500 (about A$107). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 哈尔滨市文明行为促进条例 (Harbin Civilised Behaviour Promotion Regulation)

laws.rule: Harbin: setting off fireworks is banned inside the Fourth Ring Road (including the road) and in other listed zones (item 1), and across the city during heavy air-pollution emergency response (item 3).
laws.penalty_signal: Fine amount not stated in this decision.
laws.heading: 哈尔滨市人大常委会关于禁止燃放烟花爆竹的决定 (Harbin Standing Committee Decision on Banning the Setting-off of Fireworks)

laws.rule: Unregistered electric bicycles may not be ridden on the road, and riders must follow road rules (article 26).
laws.penalty_signal: Warning, then CNY 50 (about A$10.67) if the person does not correct it. Other road-rule breaches: warning or CNY 50 (about A$10.67). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
